attributes.title: NACNS 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.organizer: National Association of Clinical Nurse Specialists
attributes.summary:
The National Association of Clinical Nurse Specialists holds its 2027 Annual Conference from March 1 to 4, 2027, at the Loews Kansas City Hotel in downtown Kansas City, Missouri. The meeting is the main yearly gathering for clinical nurse specialists, who work across patient care, nursing practice and systems improvement.

The program draws on abstracts for presentations, pharmacology sessions and posters, with a separate student poster track; both calls have closed. The conference rate at the Loews starts at $289 plus tax and is available until February 5, 2027. Registration fees and the number of contact hours had not been posted on the conference page when we checked.
